properties.name: supportingText
properties.description: Secondary descriptive text below the headline.

properties.name: divider
properties.description: Render a divider line below this item.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Render a gap (extra space) below this item — an alternative separator to divider.

properties.name: badge
properties.description: Small badge label (e.g. "New") displayed before the trailing arrow.

properties.name: openDelay
properties.description:
Hover intent — milliseconds the pointer must rest on the row before the
flyout opens. Keeps a pointer that is merely passing over the row on its
way elsewhere from opening it. `0` opens on contact. The KEYBOARD never
waits: ArrowRight / Enter / Space open immediately whatever this is set to.

properties.name: closeDelay
properties.description:
Hover intent — milliseconds an open flyout survives the pointer leaving the
row, so a diagonal from the row to the flyout can cross the sibling rows
in between without the flyout switching. Cancelled the moment the pointer
re-enters the row OR the flyout. `0` closes on exit. Escape and ArrowLeft
never wait.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

name: Sub Menu Item
description: A menu row that opens a nested submenu. Same anatomy as md-menu-item, plus a submenu slot that you fill with a second md-menu.

notes: Tap opens submenu. Browser pointer hover delays not implemented.

Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, browser form APIs, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
